judged_text: ensure_embeddable replaces an in-memory cached SiteSetting check with a live DB query (EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?) on every embed request, with no caching layer added. High-traffic embedded comment widgets now add a DB round-trip per request that previously hit the cached settings object; a slow or saturated DB now degrades the embed endpoint, which is fetched cross-origin on third-party pages.

adjudication.rationale: The diff changes embed host validation from `SiteSetting.allows_embeddable_host?(request.referer)` to `EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?(request.referer)` in `EmbedController#ensure_embeddable` (and similarly in `TopicRetriever#invalid_host?`). `EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?` calls `record_for_host`, which executes `where("lower(host) = ?", host).first`, i.e., a DB lookup per call. The diff does not introduce any caching around this new lookup, so the performance concern (extra DB round-trip on embed requests) is diff-grounded, though it’s not a functional correctness bug.
